Each example is a notebook about one place. It reads the [Landsat LST P95 composite](https://source.coop/nlebovits/landsat-lst) for an area of interest and compares it with other data for the same area, such as building footprints or tree canopy height. The [Pergamino tutorial](../tutorials/pergamino.qmd) shows the pattern from start to finish.

::: {#examples}
:::

::: lst-empty
## Contribute the first example

The gallery has no notebooks yet. If you work with heat data for a city or region, a short notebook about it helps the next reader of that place. [Contribute a notebook](../contribute/notebooks.qmd) explains the folder layout, the front matter, and the checks a pull request runs.
:::
